meaning:
συμ-βαίνω
[in LXX for עָשָׂה, קָרָא, קָרָה, etc. ;]
1. to stand with the feet together.
2. to come together, come to terms.
3. Of events, to come to pass, happen: with dative of person(s), Mrk.10:32, Act.3:10 20:19, 1Co.10:11, 1Pe.4:12, 2Pe.2:22; absol., τὰ σνμβεβηκότα, Luk.24:14 (cf. 1Ma.4:26); with accusative and nf., Act.21:35.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the…
They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.
They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and…
Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.
Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.
But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”
